statistics_interpretation.best_methods: S-J AbsRel andband better with CIexcluding0,other3cross0. S-R onlyband better with CIexcluding0. S-B0 fourdepth/band measures better with CIexcluding0,F1cross0; most gain already exists inLparent.
statistics_interpretation.final_methods: S-J onlybandCI excludes0,other4cross0. S-Lfinal AbsRel/band better,F1 worse with CIs excluding0; RMSE/delta1cross0. S-Rfinal AbsRel/RMSE/band better,F1worseCIs;delta1cross0. Comparing Sfinal with Lfinal is NOT the causal added-stage comparison.
